home.aboutTitle: From our kitchen to your table
home.aboutText: Kebabish was founded in Hoogkarspel with one goal: bringing the authentic flavors of Pakistan to West Friesland. Every dish is made fresh with care, just like at home.
home.why1Text: No ready-made meals — everything is prepared fresh every day.
home.why2Text: Traditional recipes and spices, just like home cooking.
home.why4Text: Through the website or straight via WhatsApp — whatever suits you.
home.deliveryTitle: We deliver within 10 km of Hoogkarspel
home.deliveryText: Including Bovenkarspel, Grootebroek, Lutjebroek, Westwoud, Wognum, Wervershoof and Enkhuizen.
home.ctaBannerText: Order easily through our website or send us a WhatsApp message.
home.storyImageAlt1: Marinated chicken roasting in the tandoor over open flames
home.popularNote: Prices on request — message us for the current price list.

about.title: About Kebabish
about.intro: Pakistani flavours, made with love in Hoogkarspel
about.storyTitle: From the family table to your front door
about.storyText1: Kebabish was founded in Hoogkarspel with one simple goal: bringing the authentic flavours of Pakistan to West Friesland. No shortcuts, no ready-made sauces — just fresh ingredients and traditional spices.
about.storyText2: Our tandoor isn't there for show. Everything you order is cooked fresh the same day, exactly how it would land on our own table at home.
about.ctaText: Browse the menu or send us a WhatsApp message — we deliver within 10 km of Hoogkarspel.

catering.title: Catering
catering.intro: Pakistani food for your party, event or gathering
catering.introText: From birthdays to office drinks — we prepare fresh, authentic Pakistani dishes for larger groups. Get in touch to discuss what's possible.
catering.step1Text: Send us a WhatsApp message or give us a call with a rough guest count and your preferred date.
catering.step2Text: Together we'll pick the best dishes for your occasion, tailored to what you're after.
catering.step3Title: We take care of the rest
catering.step3Text: Freshly cooked and delivered on time, so you can actually enjoy your own event.
catering.occasion1Text: Celebrate your special day with a table full of authentic flavours.
catering.occasion2Text: Give your next team outing or office drinks real Pakistani food.
catering.occasion3Text: From iftar to birthday parties — plenty for the whole family.
catering.occasion4Text: Weddings, anniversaries and other moments that call for something special.
catering.ctaText: Get in touch to discuss what's possible for your event — we're happy to think it through with you.
